fnol_text: My name is Felix Whitfield and I live at 755 Alder Lane, Milton, VT 05445. You can reach me on (555) 948-8736 or felix.whitfield@example.com. There was a flood warning for our area from the day before, but I left the car parked on the street by the river. On 24 July 2025 the water rose and the car was flooded up to the seats. Policy MT-2025-00046. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car. Can you confirm I'm covered for this?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Whitfield on (555) 948-8736 to acknowledge the claim. Felix confirmed the loss date as 24 July 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Elena O'Connell gave a statement by phone.
Felix sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
